name: Farming 10 x 10
author: Addicting Games
description: Farming 10 x 10 is a puzzle game based on farming. Farming is a tough job but you have to plant your crops of the season. You have eggplants, tomatoes, corn, wheat, and even daises. Ideally, as a good farmer, you must plant your crops in a row or column. This will make it easier to pick your crops. Once you have a completed row or column, a farmer will hop on the screen to clear out the row or column earning you points. The more rows and columns you create, the better your score. Play this online game, again again, to beat your best score while rising up the leaderboards.
